_readme: Translations for /fr/. "ui" translates the English UI strings (keys are the English text). "pages" lists translated pages: English path -> {source, title, description, headline, summary, crumb, keyword, published, updated}. "source" is the English page's "updated" date the translation was made from. "facts" (same shape as site.json facts, with this store's prices) is added with the first translated homepage or About page. See SEO-PLAYBOOK.md, Translations.

ui.Noxium. Made by Inertia Projects, an ind: Noxium. Conçu par Inertia Projects, un développeur indépendant. Étiquette de confidentialité de l’App Store : Aucune donnée collectée.
